name: LEXA Full Business Language Overhaul — guarded main-branch package
type: Language audit assets and main-branch guarded application workflow template
scope: Plain English across active frontend modules, navigation/search, shared components, user-facing errors, and language-focused regression tests. The workflow applies changes to a full main checkout and commits only after complete validation.
application_steps: Upload this ZIP itself to the repository root on main and let the existing LEXA ZIP extractor process it.
Create .github/workflows/lexa-language-overhaul.yml on main by copying docs/LEXA_LANGUAGE_OVERHAUL_WORKFLOW.yml; the extractor deliberately skips .github/workflows.
Run LEXA Full Business Language Audit on main and review the entire test/build result and subsequent main CI run.
